claims.evidence: Photo 0 front and side show the Canon EOS 600D label; witness names the model.
Photos cannot show country of prior use.
Report shows the camera on a shelf but no close-up condition inspection or optical test.
Shutter count is listed as not shown.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens caps are on both ends in Photo 0; internal fungus and fine scratches cannot be seen.
Battery health and charger inclusion are listed as not shown.
Repair history cannot be determined from photos.

risks.risk: Shutter count is unknown; high actuation could mean the shutter is near end of life.
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo of the shutter count from the camera menu or software.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if the shutter count is high or unknown.

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or charger missing; camera may not power on.
risks.proof: Photo of the original battery and charger, or a clip showing the camera powering on and taking a picture.
risks.if_unproven: Price without a working battery and charger.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus or scratches; sensor may be dirty or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens front and rear without caps, plus a test photo showing a clean sensor.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if the lens has fungus or the sensor is defective.

risks.risk: Camera may not function; buttons, dials, or LCD could be faulty.
risks.proof: Video clip of the camera powering on, focusing, shooting, and reviewing an image.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or untested.

risks.risk: Original box, manuals, and warranty documents may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the box, manuals, and any warranty papers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body and lens only, without accessories.

proof_requests: Shutter count screenshot or menu photo
Video of the camera powering on, focusing, shooting, and reviewing an image
Lens front and rear photos without caps
Photo of the original battery and charger
Photo of original box, manuals, and warranty documents
response.reason: The witness identifies a Canon EOS 600D body with lens, so a worst-case price is possible; the seller's condition and history claims are unproven.
